archived_url_discovery.method: Public archive.org/wayback/available lookup for the exact newly discovered PDF URL
archived_url_discovery.note: Archive availability response supplied the captured original HTTP URL. Raw archived payload was retrieved through verified HTTPS with id_ and actual Memento checked; no CDX digest-match claim.

page_locators.claim: Cover names both editions and announces 8–11 February 2022 as a virtual exhibition.
Title page identifies DESM/NCERT as organiser; New Delhi is printed organiser context, not independent evidence of physical attendance.
English preface describes the planned combined online 47th/48th event and the separate 2020/2021 themes.
Preface identifies the booklet as an overview and is dated December 2021; this is not a full original construction-report volume.
Bilingual contents separates Part I, 2020, with seven sections, from Part II, 2021, with five sections.
Representative bilingual entry contains a single exhibit code, shared credits and parallel Hindi/English synopses, not two exhibits.
Last numbered Notes page; PDF 188 is the publisher back cover.

review_scope: All 188 native text layers were extracted and screened. All 145 English school/address blocks were read in text and as source-rendered crops across seven contact sheets, covering all seven 2020 sections and all five 2021 sections; no block remained unparsed. Full cover, title, English preface, contents, part-boundary, sample-entry, last-notes and back-cover pages were read visually. This is not a full reading or technical validation of every synopsis, or a line-by-line bilingual translation audit.
notes: This is a newly received body, with no SHA256 match among sources registered at baseline 1287f36. Hindi and English run in parallel for each exhibit. The count of 145 refers to distinct edition/code/credit blocks, not 290 language versions, unique schools, pupils or attendees. No confidently Kerala-located school was identified in the 145 reviewed addresses; this does not establish nonparticipation in either event or outside this booklet. The December 2021 preface, PDF creation on 3 February 2022, archive capture on 5 February 2022 and announced 8–11 February 2022 event remain distinct. This is a selected-exhibit synopsis booklet, separate from the edited Structure and Working chapter collection and original school logbooks. It adds no Kerala method case, award, code-authorship, qualifying-route or performance validation. The current HTTPS host failed DNS; the archived body was acquired normally without retrying the stopped GIPE or partial 2010 routes.

notes: Candidate correspondence to the existing HealthCareDevice record uses the published author name, school/region wording, manual platform-lifting mechanism and INSPIRE-MANAK reference.
